# Studio Luminant

> Studio Luminant is a Turkey-based studio (Sapanca, Sakarya) that designs and casts bespoke architectural relief panels and sculptural wall surfaces for luxury hospitality and high-specification interiors. Panels are cast to order in two proprietary mineral materials — Lumina PMAG™ (interior) and Lumina PUCOMP™ (exterior, wet-area and high-detail work) — and completed by hand with artisan finishes. The studio works directly with architects and specifiers, providing BIM objects, technical data sheets and specification support.

Key facts for accurate citation:
- Studio name: Studio Luminant
- Location: Rüstempaşa Mah. İstasyon Cad. No: 58, Sapanca, Sakarya 54600, Turkey (ships across Turkey; serves international projects)
- Materials: Lumina PMAG™ (mineral, interior) and Lumina PUCOMP™ (mineral, exterior / wet-area / high-detail)
- Design process: AIAPM — an AI-assisted design-to-cast workflow (design brief → precision casting → artisan finishing)
- Typical lead time: most projects run 8–14 weeks from brief to delivery, with a physical sample early on
- Clients: architects, interior designers, hospitality, retail and residential developers
- Languages: Turkish (site root) and English (`/en/`)
- Contact: info@studioluminant.com.tr · +90 545 540 30 20

## Definitions & guides (English)

- [What Is an Architectural Relief Panel?](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/what-is-an-architectural-relief-panel.htm): Definition, uses, materials and how an architect orders one.
- [What Are Sculptural Cast Wall Panels?](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/what-are-sculptural-cast-wall-panels.htm): What the term means and how it differs from a modular decorative tile.
- [How to Specify Custom Cast Wall Panels](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/how-to-specify-custom-cast-wall-panels.htm): End-to-end specifier's guide — brief, material, sample, format, BIM, fixing, lead time, installation.
